pattern: SELECT .+ COUNT\(.*\) as total\_[A-Za-z]+\sFROM\s[A-Za-z]+\_Programs JOIN Departments ON [A-Za-z]+\_Programs\.\w+ = Departments\.\w+ WHERE Departments\.department\_name = 'Engineering' GROUP BY department\_name
correction: Count the total number of departments instead of degree programs by using COUNT(*) and removing the grouping.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that count the wrong entity (degree program) and corrects it by counting the total number of departments instead.
